newsitem.title: USA: Bally Total Fitness Q4 loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Bally Total Fitness Q4 loss widens.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Full company name is Bally Total Fitness Holdings Corp, which was spun off from Bally Entertainment Corp January 8, 1996.

Fourth quarter and full year 1996 results include $5.7 million gain on extraordinary extingushiment of debt, which includes a gain (net of taxes) of $9.9 million, or $0.81 a share, resulting from the forgiveness of debt owed Bally Entertainment, forgiven as part of the December 1996 merger of Bally Entertainment with Hilton Hotels Corp and a charge (net of taxes) of $4.2 million, or $0.35 a share, resulting from the December 1996 refinancing of the company's securitization facility.

The historical net loss for the year and quarter ended December 31, 1995 of $25.2 million and $12.6 million, respectively, reflected a federal income tax benefit of $11.3 million and $5.8 million, respectively, arising from the company's prior tax sharing agreement with Bally Entertainment. 1995 results were pro forma.
